items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Well it was Harold Bidjohn, George Gano, a big guy, myself

ctx.x: Listen, who all played at Haydell's? I'm going to get that straight.

Well it was Harold Bidjohn, George Gano, a big guy, myself, and then they had a little little daddy playing piano one time, Wiggy played piano a while, and then Smitty, actor who stayed the longest, John Smith.
But no change in the other three, just change in the chord? No. Well that's fantastic. You really stuck together a long time.

items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: Lionel Fabos wrote in the red one for it. Beautiful.

ctx.x: 된 된 된 된 된 된 된 된 된 된 My heart is beautiful, it's my only illusion. It's my life without your love. For me it's nothing more than more pain. Chico mia, con tuya... Chico mia, en mis ensueños es tuya, y no otra ninguna, es en mi corazón que tu. Chico mia, con tus ojos bonita, y tu pelo negrita, como la noche de sendú. Yo sería, yo te amas quería, y tu cara bonita, es mi solo y es tu amor. Chico mia, en mis ensueños es tuya, y no otra ninguna, es en mi corazón que tu. Lionel Fabos wrote in the red one on it, that boy…
